observations: Photo 0 shows a single large rectangular solar panel with a grid of dark photovoltaic cells and a metal frame.
No visible brand/model label, watt rating, serial number, or sticker is readable in the photo.
No inverter, battery, charge controller, mounting hardware, or wiring is shown.

claims.claim: Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution...
claims.evidence: Only a solar panel is visible; no system components or specs are shown.

risks.risk: Panel wattage/efficiency class is unknown (price depends heavily on Wp rating).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel’s label/sticker showing watt rating (e.g., 100W/150W/200W/300W), model, and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest plausible category for a used single panel (worst-case: lower-watt or unknown condition).

risks.risk: Condition/health is unknown (possible cracks, micro-cracks, delamination, or reduced output).
risks.proof: A photo of the panel surface from multiple angles plus a performance test (IV curve or at least a working measurement under sun).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to meet rated output (worst-case: reduced performance).

risks.risk: Whether it is complete for installation is unknown (only the panel is shown; missing mounting and balance-of-system).
risks.proof: List of what’s included with photos: mounting rails/brackets, junction box condition, cables/connectors, and any controller/inverter/battery if claimed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as panel-only (worst-case: buyer must source all other components).

risks.risk: Authenticity/ownership and any warranty status is unknown.
risks.proof: Proof of purchase or warranty card/serial verification photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price without warranty support (worst-case: no warranty).

proof_requests: Close-up of the panel nameplate/sticker (brand, model, serial number, and watt rating).
Photos of the panel corners and backsheet/junction box area (to check damage).
A working test result (IV curve or measured output under sunlight) or a video showing it producing power.
Confirm what is included in the sale (panel only vs full solar system components).
response.reason: From the photo, it appears to be a single solar panel, but the key pricing driver (brand/model and watt rating) and condition proof are not readable or shown. Without the label and a performance/condition check, any price would be guesswork.
